name: The mark opens into a ring of integrations
looks: A single app icon glows alone at centre, then curved lines reach out to four partner tool icons arriving one at a time around it, forming a small hub-and-spoke diagram. A short tagline naming the tool count and supported protocols settles beneath once the ring completes.
build: Centre icon is fixed with a subtle pulse; each spoke is a curved bezier path drawing outward (`strokeDashoffset`, 200-300ms), staggered 100-150ms apart, its partner icon popping in the instant its line finishes. Tagline fades in only once the last spoke lands.
sound: A soft whoosh per spoke drawing, a light pop on each partner icon, a confirming tick under the tagline.
prompt: Glow a single product icon alone at centre, then draw curved lines out to a small ring of partner tool icons arriving one at a time, each popping in as its own line completes, settling a short tagline naming the scale of what connects underneath once the ring is whole.
